goal: 让当前材料可直接被正式消费者读取，并在记录 analyzer 前拒绝显式错误身份。
non_goals: 不新增材料、阶段或转换层
stop_conditions: 需要第五份材料、转换层或放宽严格 parser
expected_handoff: 当前 spec/plan/tasks 可原样消费；错误 analyzer 身份在保存前明确失败。

red.result: 1 targeted assertion failed because explicit analyzer stage identity was accepted before the fix.

green.result: 2 tests passed; current materials round-trip and wrong analyzer identity is rejected without sidecar mutation.

coverage_limits: 不证明真实宿主生成内容
不做产品 UI 或浏览器验收
